name: Stremio PiP
author: DefnoJae
description: Adds a Picture-in-Picture button to the Stremio v5 player using the native HTML video Picture-in-Picture API.

compat._comment: WebMod metadata. Runtime capability detection is preferred because Stremio's web UI updates continuously.
